actual:
BUG-171 end-to-end validation exposed workflow efficiency regressions even when ignoring the accidental stop/idle time.

Observed problems:
- Agents can still run broad repo searches instead of staying inside allowed_write_scope and Context Pack.
- Successful validation and GitHub check commands still emit large JSON / long logs into chat.
- run --mode pr can fail late when changes are uncommitted instead of returning a compact commit_required preflight.
- PR checks can be queried before checks exist and treated as a hard failure instead of pending/retry.
- Fix worktrees may not contain the newly registered BUG JSON, causing finish/resume to fail with BUG record not found.
- close-sync / merge-finalizer paths can require fallback and extra tool calls.

Expected behavior:
- New Codex and Claude Code windows should default to the latest optimized workflow: scoped reads/searches, compact success output, clear preflight next actions, retryable CI watch, and no full JSON/statusCheckRollup output unless explicitly requested.
- The standard workflow must preserve issue linkage, allowed scope, targeted validation, PR CI, close-sync, cleanup, and production gates.

Acceptance criteria:
- Workflow docs/client skill tell all windows to use scoped reads/searches and compact outputs by default.
- Workflow CLI provides or improves compact helpers/preflight so agents do not need broad rg or full statusCheckRollup.
- PR preflight reports uncommitted changes and missing BUG JSON before PR creation.
- Check watch treats missing checks as pending/retry rather than immediate business failure when possible.
- Validation proves no root pollution and workflow smoke passes.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
